builds.name: Reference: Ranked bot core
builds.goal: Reference for Twitch: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ bot players use most (19,212 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 57.2% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A stealth ambusher who builds poison before Contaminate and uses extended-range piercing attacks to pressure aligned enemies. The current adc provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: The Collector → Fiendhunter Bolts → Infinity Edge. Lethal Tempo keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Berserker's Greaves, Lord Dominik's Regards, Guardian Angel.
builds.summary: The proven bot baseline: The Collector → Fiendhunter Bolts → Infinity Edge, with Lethal Tempo.
testPlan: Play it in bot as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (The Collector → Fiendhunter Bolts → Infinity Edge) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 57.2% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: The Collector → Fiendhunter Bolts → Infinity Edge.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

builds.name: Venom true finish
builds.summary: Test AP poison ticking into Shadowflame's low-health threshold.
builds.goal: Test AP poison ticking into Shadowflame's low-health threshold.
builds.hypothesis: Passive poison gains 0.03 AP true damage per stack per second up to six stacks; E adds 0.35 AP magic damage per stack. W's AP slow can retain targets while Nashor supplies the attacks to stack poison. Shadowflame explicitly amplifies low-health magic and true damage.
testPlan: Required state: Six earned stacks, recorded remaining duration and target crosses below 40% health.
Log poison ticks and E physical/magic components above and below threshold at fixed stacks.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Shielding or early E before full stacks limits the proposed finisher; AP loses ordinary R attack pressure.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Void Staff supports E magic damage but does not penetrate poison's true damage.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, Cosmic Drive, Void Staff, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Critical duel
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Twitch: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A stealth ambusher who builds poison before Contaminate and uses extended-range piercing attacks to pressure aligned enemies. Fix poison stacks and R piercing attack lines. AP Contaminate and attack routes are different; verify bolt/phantom poison behavior and spell/attack contact separately. Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows.
builds.summary: Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Twitch: Fix poison stacks and R piercing attack lines. AP Contaminate and attack routes are different; verify bolt/phantom poison behavior and spell/attack contact separately.

Start with the early core (Kraken, then Navori if attack-driven recycling works) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Twitch becomes Camouflaged for a short duration and gains Move Speed. When leaving Camouflage, Twitch gains Attack Speed for a short duration.

When an enemy champion with Deadly Venom dies, Ambush's cooldown is reset. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: A Lifeline slot excludes Sterak/Maw; melee access or ranged spacing must be earned.

The route fails Twitch's stated kit question: Fix poison stacks and R piercing attack lines. AP Contaminate and attack routes are different; verify bolt/phantom poison behavior and spell/attack contact separately.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: A Lifeline slot excludes Sterak/Maw; melee access or ranged spacing must be earned.
Full cost 16,550 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Kraken, then Navori if attack-driven recycling works. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Infinity Edge, Immortal Shieldbow, Lord Dominik's Regards are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Spray bolt distribution
builds.summary: Test extra on-hit target coverage during R instead of assuming every bolt duplicates spray.
builds.goal: Test extra on-hit target coverage during R instead of assuming every bolt duplicates spray.
builds.hypothesis: R turns attacks into piercing bolts for six seconds with attenuation on later targets. Runaan separately fires on-hit bolts, and Statikk's energized chain explicitly applies on-hits. Terminus supports mixed attack packets; Q's stealth-exit attack speed gives a finite opening to distribute poison.
testPlan: Required state: Several targets in controlled alignment, Q exit buff and R active; energized state recorded.
Count poison stacks and item packets on each aligned/off-axis target with Runaan and Statikk separately equipped.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Misalignment, dodgeable piercing attacks or short contact leaves expensive spread slots unused.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Runaan bolts are not proven to become additional full piercing R attacks.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Runaan's Hurricane, Statikk Shiv, Blade of The Ruined King, Terminus, Bloodthirster, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
